standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of invertible modules as those admitting a module whose tensor product with them is the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked twice in the counted proof (source lines 4367 and 4373) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the inverse of the given module and tests invertibility of its pullback.

standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the pullback with the tensor product of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 4370-4372 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the trivialising isomorphism along the pullback.

core_obligations: Take an inverse: by the characterisation of invertible modules the proof chooses a module whose tensor product with the given one is the structure sheaf (proof lines 4367-4369)

Pull back: applying the pullback to that isomorphism and using its compatibility with the tensor product gives an isomorphism between the tensor product of the pulled back modules and the structure sheaf of the source (proof lines 4370-4372)
Conclude: the pulled back module therefore admits an inverse, so it is invertible (proof lines 4372-4373)
proof_roadmap: 由可逆模的刻画，取 N 使 L ⊗_{O_Y} N ≅ O_Y。
对同构作用 f^*，并用 f^* 与张量积相容（本章引理）得 f^*L ⊗_{O_X} f^*N ≅ O_X，故 f^*L 可逆。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of an invertible module is invertible (author lemma at source lines 4359-4364, label lemma-pullback-invertible). The proof (source lines 4366-4374) chooses an inverse of the given module, pulls back the trivialising isomorphism and uses the compatibility of the pullback with the tensor product to exhibit an inverse of the pulled back module (proof lines 4367-4373). The transport of the trivialisation along the pullback is the content. H2.
